final: WITH circuit_averages AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), country_baselines AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_round) AS baseline FROM circuit_averages GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.avg_round, ca.avg_round - cb.baseline AS difference FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_baselines AS cb ON ca.country = cb.country OR (ca.country IS NULL AND cb.country IS NULL) ORDER BY (difference IS NULL), difference DESC LIMIT 10
